======================================================================
               DIST FOLDER - STANDALONE EXECUTABLE
======================================================================

On Windows:
  Run "build_exe.bat" in the main project folder.
  It will automatically create "HostelRegisterGenerator.exe" in this folder.

Once built, you can copy "HostelRegisterGenerator.exe" anywhere (such as
the Desktop or a USB drive) and run it on any Windows computer without
installing Python.
======================================================================
